This topic is part of the IB HL IBDP Design Technology specification.

Human Factors & Ergonomics appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Human Factors & Ergonomics in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The IB HL board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Human Factors & Ergonomics.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
